title: Configuration width bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. The width $W_M(n,s)$ of its configuration encoding satisfies $W_M(n,s)\le (|\mathrm{State}(M)|+6k+5)(s+n+1)$, where $|\mathrm{State}(M)|$ is the number of machine states.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
